title: Fleet
description: Box health, runners, AI spend and the agent queue on one screen.

panels.title: Decisions
panels.description: Open issues labelled needs-nish-decision.

options.content:
Open a row to stop, redo or comment on GitHub.
To give an order in words, use the Fleet control chat in the Claude app.
A click on Open opens that issue or run in a new tab.

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description: Open issues labelled agent-ready.

panels.title: Claimed
panels.description: Counts the Being worked on now table. A claim can outlive its run; "Running now" is the live count.

panels.title: Running now
panels.description: Agent jobs actually running right now (see the table below).

panels.title: Failed, retrying
panels.description: Open issues that failed once and were re-queued to the senior lane (strong-only + an "agent run failed" comment).

panels.title: Stuck
panels.description: Open issues labelled agent-blocked or needs-orchestrator.

panels.title: To merge
panels.description: Open pull requests across Nishfleet and Drive.

panels.title: Shipped
panels.description: Pull requests merged across Nishfleet and Drive in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Being worked on now
panels.description: Open issues labelled agent-in-progress. Claimed counts this table.

panels.title: Running now
panels.description: agent-dispatch runs started in the last 3 hours that have not finished (0509, fleet-ops, TinyStudio.io-public, drive). Click a row to open the run.

panels.title: Broken services
panels.description: systemd units in the failed state.

panels.title: AI seats working
panels.description: LiteLLM deployments answering normally.

panels.title: AI seats struggling
panels.description: Deployments with some failures (LiteLLM partial outage).

panels.title: AI seats down
panels.description: Deployments LiteLLM marks as a full outage.

panels.title: Which AI seats are not healthy
Swap used
panels.description: Overflow memory kept on disk when RAM is full.

panels.title: CPU pressure
panels.description: Percentage of wall time runnable tasks waited for a CPU, from node_exporter's node_pressure_cpu_waiting_seconds_total. This is the pressure stall signal from /proc/pressure/cpu: how much of the time work that wanted a core was waiting for one.

panels.title: Processor busy
panels.description: Whole-host processor busy percent, the denominator the pressure above is measured against.

panels.title: CPU pressure over time
panels.description: The pressure alert fires when the 15-minute line stays above 25% for 15 minutes. The host was last measured at load 21 on 12 cores (2026-10-05) with nothing showing where the time went.

panels.title: 0509.io up
panels.description: Homepage answers with a 2xx every 30s (blackbox exporter).

panels.title: Backups: last run
panels.description: restic → Cloudflare R2 timers on the box. Daily backup should be under ~25h.

panels.title: Paid AI spend, 24h
panels.description: LiteLLM's cost estimate for model calls in the last 24 hours. Prepaid and free seats count as $0.

panels.title: AI spend per hour, by model
